name: Shahoko
biography: Homara minax. A colossal lobster yokai whose shielded claw doubles as a rampart and whose other claw is a living water cannon, raining aimed elemental pulses on anyone who lingers. Habitat: Coast.

features.name: Aqueous Affinity
features.description: The shahoko can breathe air and water.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The shahoko makes three attacks, using Hydrocannon or Leg in any combination.

features.name: Hydrocannon
features.description: The shahoko fires a blast of pressurized water out of its claw. Ranged Weapon Attack: +9, range 90/360 ft. (180/720 ft. if the shahoko is submerged in at least 5 feet of water). Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Leg
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

features.name: Aqua Jet
features.description: The shahoko uses a blast of water to propel itself up to 20 feet in a direction of its choice without provoking Opportunity Attacks. If the shahoko is submerged in at least 5 feet of water, it moves up to 40 feet instead.

features.name: Shell Shield
features.description: The shahoko guards itself with its shielded claw. It gains a +3 bonus to AC until the start of its next turn or until it is Incapacitated.

features.name: Dark Pulse (Legendary Action)
features.description:
Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the shahoko can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The shahoko regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns. When the shahoko takes aim with a Legendary Action, the point it targets glows with faint but noticeable magic until the effect occurs.

The shahoko takes aim at a point within 60 feet of it. At the end of the next enemy's turn, a blast of necrotic energy fills a 20-foot-radius Sphere centred on that point. Saving Throw: DC 17 Constitution, each creature in the area. Failure: 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. Success or Failure: The area is filled with magical darkness until the end of the shahoko's next turn.

features.name: Draconic Pulse (Legendary Action)
features.description: The shahoko takes aim at a point within 60 feet of it. At the end of the next enemy's turn, an elemental explosion fills a 30-foot-radius Sphere centred on that point. Saving Throw: DC 17 Dexterity, each creature in the area. Failure: 14 (4d6) Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison damage (shahoko's choice when it takes this action). Success: Half damage.

features.name: Forceful Pulse (Legendary Action)
features.description: The shahoko takes aim at a point within 120 feet of it. At the end of the next enemy's turn, a concussive blast fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere centred on that point. Saving Throw: DC 17 Strength, each creature in the area. Failure: 10 (3d6) Force damage, and the target is knocked Prone. Success: Half damage only.
